adoption_opportunity: Teach Decodex Control Plane remote-execution paths to preserve environment cwd as a `PathUri`, keep remote primary cwd values instead of replacing them with the local fallback, and use the selected remote environment shell when composing unified exec commands.
caveats: The PR does not make arbitrary permission-request paths cross-host safe; upstream still falls back when request-permissions needs a cwd native to the Codex host.
changed_surfaces: app-server thread and turn environment request conversion
community_value: High for remote executor and app-server users because the change makes cross-OS cwd and shell handling observable and test-backed instead of collapsing remote environments onto the local host cwd and shell.
compatibility_risk: High. Control planes or app-server clients that assume selected environment cwd is always a host-native absolute path, or that build remote commands with the session shell, can route remote Windows or foreign-OS exec turns incorrectly.
control_plane_relevance: High. Decodex Control Plane remote execution depends on app-server environment selections, cwd preservation, and shell choice matching the target environment.
deprecated_or_breaking_notes: No feature is removed, but `TurnEnvironmentSelection.cwd` is now URI-shaped and remote primary cwd values are intentionally preserved; callers should not normalize every selected environment cwd back to the local fallback.
evidence: PR #28122 says the slice changes `TurnEnvironmentSelection.cwd` from `AbsolutePathBuf` to `PathUri`, preserves a remote primary cwd, and uses the environment native shell so a real Windows process can run.
`codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs` stores `TurnEnvironmentSelection.cwd` as `PathUri` and only rewrites the primary environment cwd when the environment id is `local`.

`codex-rs/core/src/environment_selection.rs` builds default selections with `PathUri::from_abs_path`, converts selected cwd with `to_abs_path()`, and records the environment shell from `environment.info()`.
`codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs` and `turn_processor.rs` convert app-server environment cwd values with `PathUri::from_abs_path` before passing selections into core.

`codex-rs/core/src/tools/handlers/unified_exec/exec_command.rs` resolves commands with the selected turn environment shell, falling back to `session.user_shell()` only when no environment shell is reported.
`codex-rs/core/tests/remote_env_windows/remote_env_windows_test.rs` asserts remote Windows exec starts through `pwsh.exe`, proving the remote environment shell path is exercised.
The normalized bundle `artifacts/github/bundles/openai-codex-pr-28122.json` records 22 changed files and 13 commits for the merged PR.
